Parse(Token, CommandOverload, int, bool)

Tries to parse the overload from the first token of a sequence.

public static CommandOverloadParser.ParseResult Parse(Token firstToken, CommandOverload overload, int cursorPosition, bool computeAutoComplete)

Parameters

firstToken Token

The first token to start parsing from.

overload CommandOverload

The overload we're trying to parse.

cursorPosition int

The position of the cursor for the autocomplete. Use 0 when computeAutoComplete is false, if you don't have it make it the length of the input text.

computeAutoComplete bool

Whether or not to compute the auto complete options, this also changes the behavior compared to parsing for execution, being a little more lenient to incomplete values.

Returns

CommandOverloadParser.ParseResult

The result of the parsing.

Exceptions

ArgumentOutOfRangeException

Is thrown when parsing an unknown command type from the overload, you shouldn't have to worry about this.
